secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase Project URL — from Supabase Dashboard > Project Settings > API > Project URL

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase Anon (public) Key — from Supabase Dashboard > Project Settings > API > anon public

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase Service Role Key — from Supabase Dashboard > Project Settings > API > service_role (server-only, never expose in browser)

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API Key — from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com)

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenRouter API Key (fallback AI) — from openrouter.ai > Keys

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API Key for sending emails — from resend.com > API Keys

secrets.name: DODO_PAYMENTS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Dodo Payments API Key for subscription management — from Dodo Payments Dashboard

secrets.name: DODO_PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Dodo Payments Webhook Secret for verifying webhook signatures

secrets.name: DODO_PRODUCT_SOLO_MONTHLY
secrets.description: Dodo Payments product ID for Solo plan (monthly). Find in Dodo dashboard > Products.

secrets.name: DODO_PRODUCT_SOLO_ANNUAL
secrets.description: Dodo Payments product ID for Solo plan (annual). Find in Dodo dashboard > Products.

secrets.name: DODO_PRODUCT_AGENCY_MONTHLY
secrets.description: Dodo Payments product ID for Agency plan (monthly). Find in Dodo dashboard > Products.

secrets.name: DODO_PRODUCT_AGENCY_ANNUAL
secrets.description: Dodo Payments product ID for Agency plan (annual). Find in Dodo dashboard > Products.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
secrets.description: Public URL of the app (e.g. https://your-domain.com). Used for payment redirects and email links.
